options.navigate: go to a web address the words name: a website, a host or a url
options.search: search for the words: on the web, or on this site when they point at something on it
options.back: go back to the previous page
options.press: press a key: enter, escape, space or an arrow key
options.read: read the page aloud or show its contents
options.clear: clear the text in the focused field
options.stop: stop what the browser is doing
options.none: not a command for this page: a remark, a question, a name, noise
options.play: music: find a song or video by the words and play it now, on YouTube or on this site as the words point — never the page's play button, which is a click
options.play_next: music: find a song by the words and play it after the one playing
options.queue: music: find a song by the words and add it to the end of the queue

slot.instructions: Which words of the transcript are the thing the command carries verbatim: the address to open, the search terms, the song to play, the text to type, the key to press? Never the command word itself: "play X" carries X. Choose none when it carries none.

options.none: the command carries no words of its own

extent.instructions: Only when the action scrolls the page or a scrolling part of it: how far? Choose words when the words give a number of screens or pages; screen when they say nothing of how far. Ignored for every other action.

options.words: as many screens as the number the words carry
options.little: a little: a third of a screen
options.screen: one screen, as Page Down does
options.end: all the way: to the bottom, or to the top going up
